svg.title: Food-chain model: reset, run, record
svg.desc: Paper model starts with six leaf tokens, six caterpillar cards and two bird cards. Each caterpillar needs one leaf token; each bird needs two fed caterpillar cards. Compare six leaves with three leaves, resetting and repeating each condition three times.

g.text: Rule: each bird needs 2 fed caterpillar cards.
Count fed caterpillars, then birds with enough food.
Reset all cards. Run each leaf condition 3 times.
Paper model only. Living things are not removed from a habitat.
